author: Fusion VR
title: Hiring Mid & Senior 3D Character Modeling Artists
content:
We’re Hiring: Mid & Senior 3D Character Modeling Artists

Bring characters to life at FusionVR!

We’re looking for talented 3D Character Modeling Artists who can take ownership of characters from sculpting through modeling, texturing, shading, grooming, and MetaHuman / Unreal Engine integration for cinematic, real-time, and immersive experiences.

Role Responsibilities
• Translate the director’s vision into character designs and contribute to style, personality, and visual direction.
• Create hyper-realistic and stylized characters from concept to final delivery.
• Handle modeling, sculpting, retopology, UVs, texturing, shading, and grooming.
• Prepare and optimize characters for MetaHuman / Unreal Engine integration.
• Deliver presentation-ready characters for cinematic, real-time, and immersive VR projects.

Requirements
• Mid-Level: Minimum 5 years of professional experience.
• Senior-Level: Minimum 10 years of professional experience.
• Strong portfolio in likeness sculpting, realistic/stylized characters, creature design, texturing, and grooming.
• Strong understanding of anatomy, proportions, facial structure, character design, and hyper-realistic detailing.
• Proficiency in Maya, Blender, and Unreal Engine.
• Hands-on experience with character grooming/hair creation.
• Experience with MetaHuman or MetaHuman-compatible character pipelines is highly preferred.
• Ability to independently take a character from concept/sculpt to final textured, groomed, and engine-ready asset.

Apply Now: application form link in the first comment on the Facebook post.
